title: DBFlux redesign: Bolt Byzantium design system
brief: Imported from Claude.ai artifact RrT5VLW14vaPQzV1ab71hT: the Bolt Byzantium design system (foundations, brand, app and web components, interaction states).

artboards.title: Brand & app icons
artboards.tradeoff: Brand and app icons: keeps the amber bolt consistent across sizes; covers identity only.

artboards.title: Foundations
artboards.tradeoff: Foundations sheet: every token in one board for exact reuse; long to scan.

artboards.title: Web components
artboards.tradeoff: Web components: site building blocks that match the app; no page composition.

artboards.title: App components
artboards.tradeoff: App components: the desktop building blocks in one place; no full screens.

artboards.title: App component plan
artboards.tradeoff: Component plan: maps each app component to its build order; planning, not visuals.

artboards.title: Interaction states
artboards.tradeoff: Interaction states: hover, focus, pressed and disabled side by side; static, no live behavior.
